## The everyday decision

How should we interpret the prices of bread, eggs and milk when looking back
at a grocery budget?

## The evidence

Three ALFRED workbooks contain monthly U.S. city average prices for January
2018 through May 2023, using a June 13, 2023 vintage. Their files were created
in November 2026. Bread is priced per pound, eggs per dozen, and milk per
gallon, so raw levels are not interchangeable.

Average price series describe observed price levels; the source recommends
using CPI indices rather than these averages to measure price change. A fixed
vintage is not a stream of new weekly releases.

## Status

Two grocery analyses have been executed retrospectively: g01 on November 13,
2026, and g07 on November 24, 2026. Their draft posts and aggregate exports
remain excluded from publication.

The g01 analysis already includes per-series quality checks and a three-panel
price history. These outputs overlap the proposals for g02-g06 and g09, but
do not establish separate work or posts for those coverage dates. Those
entries remain proposed, not completed. The normalized-level analysis
proposed for g08 has not been executed. Four weeks from August 9 through
August 30 remain unassigned because no distinct milestone is supported.

For September 13 through December 6, 2023, g10 remains a proposed comparison
of the workbooks' series definitions and units. For December 13, 2023 through
March 6, 2024, g11 remains a proposal to compare selected historical windows;
it is not a claim of work in 2024. The other 12 weeks in that range remain
unassigned.
The public grocery repository history begins with its
[initial commit](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/grocery-changes/commit/ae661351a4906997e914f600adaa449dedef9a5c)
on November 13, 2026; it does not establish work during either coverage
period. No additional analyses or posts are supported by the available
evidence.

For March 13 through June 5, 2024, g12 remains proposed, but depends on g06
and g08, which have not been executed; no synthesis or result is available.
The other grocery weeks in this range remain unassigned.
